    Polynomial families of vectors (toward Proposition 12.8) #

    A family t ↦ f t of vectors indexed by parameter values t : I → k is polynomial (IsPoly) if it is a finite sum Σ_j t^{e_j} v_j of monomials with vector coefficients. These are the specializations of the k[t_i]-valued data of deformation-refinements.tex. Polynomial families are closed under sums, linear and bilinear maps; over an infinite field a polynomial family vanishing on the torus t_i ≠ 0 vanishes identically (IsPoly.eq_zero_of_torus).
